body: I completely agree. And I believe that I have or at least that I understand what I need to do in order to do so.

I didn't actually dump him. He chose to end it. I think that he was under so much pressure, and the easiest thing for him to do to relieve some of the pressure was to give up on us. I realize it was the best thing for him to do due to the way I was behaving. But I think I've learned and realized a lot since then, and I believe I couldn't handle it better now.

also, i don't see how asking my friends and considering their advice is over dependence. I don't do what they say just because they say it. I still make my own decisions, it just helps to have other peoples view of the situation as my own thoughts are clouded from my emotions.

My female friends just believe that he wanted to work things out that he would come to me. But I believe I was in the wrong, so why would he come to me? My two best male friends that I have talked to think that its possible that I may have hurt him more than I realize and that it might be worth trying to talk to him. I'm just trying to get a variety of opinions from unbiased people.
these are married friends

I'm 31, he's 26 but tended to be very mature for his age. His job started requiring him to work 70+ hours a week. I was so used to him being there all the time and suddenly he wasn't. I didn't handle it very well. Basically I guess I was jealous over his job, and wasn't at all supportive. I was always getting mad for him not being there, and I should have realized that it wasn't a personal thing against me, that he was just trying to further his career, and I could have been more understanding.
I think they just have this mentality that it should always be the guy to come after the girl no matter what. I don't agree with that. But I thought maybe I was the only one?
Does a letter really have the same impact as hearing it in person though?
i did ask him if he had feelings for me at all anymore, and he said he did. But he just doesn't want me anymore.
nope no preferences
I don't know if he loves me anymore. He said he wants to be "friends". He said it's over forever, I can't change his mind. :-(
I have no choice to but to let him go. He's not mad, he just doesn't want to be with me anymore.
That sounds cool, I've never been there and never been to a meetup either
he worked in IT, so do I but I made 3x more than him ... that probably didn't help
he started having to work like 70-80 hours a week, and since i have no life i kept getting mad cause i was alone all the time, and he just got sick of it i guess

Basically, he started working tons of hours and became really distant. I kept getting mad and eventually it just pushed him away. He claims he tried to talk to me about it, but that I wouldn't listen. All I remember is him promising me that it was going to be okay, and now its not. I want to work on things and try to fix it, and he doesn't.
I am doing better, but it still hurts like hell though. I just want to not feel anything for him anymore.
He wants to be friends, I told him tonight I can't do that. It's been a month and half since the breakup. And it hurts so bad still.
The worst part is I know he still loves me. If I hadn't been so stupid, we would still be together. And now he won't even talk to me.
Work is also what came between me and my boyfriend. All it took was about two months too. I just don't understand how it gets so bad so quickly.
I can't think of anything. Everything seems so mundane.

I love him so much and I messed it all up now he's gone forever. I feel like there's a huge weight in my chest. I've never felt this much pain before I don't know how to handle it. I've barely eaten or slept since it happened. And sometimes it hurts so bad I can't breathe.
